calculation.description: Fade each asset's cumulative five-session return after removing the contemporaneous cross-sectional mean return on each completed session. The residual signal isolates relative moves from common benchmark direction; signals are ranked cross-sectionally for portfolio construction.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year: 2020 0.05393, 2021 0.05074, 2022 0.05799, 2023 0.06157, 2024 0.01212, 2025 0.03725, and 2026 0.02201. Recent 2024 onward remained positive but below the full-sample stability gate (ICIR 0.06472); 2025 onward was near the gate (ICIR 0.08412), while 2026 was weaker (ICIR 0.06186). Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative uncertainty interpretation.
